def transform(grid):
    # Fold the four diagonal arms of the input into the corresponding 3x3 pattern.
    n = len(grid)
    m = n // 2
    return [
        [grid[0][0], grid[1][1], grid[0][-1]],
        [grid[1][-2], grid[m][m], grid[-2][1]],
        [grid[-1][0], grid[-2][-2], grid[-1][-1]],
    ]
PY
